description_en: Prefetches content from the origin server to cache nodes. This ensures that initial requests hit the cache directly and reduces the load on the origin server
description_zh: 将源站的内容主动预热到缓存节点上。您首次访问可直接命中缓存，缓解源站压力
name: PushObjectCache

parameters.help_en:
The URLs to prefetch. Format: accelerated domain name/file to prefetch.

Separate multiple URLs with line breaks. The maximum length of a single ObjectPath is 1,024 characters
parameters.help_zh:
预热URL，格式为加速域名/预热的文件。

多个URL之间用换行符分隔，ObjectPath的单条长度最长为1024个字符
parameters.name: object_path

parameters.help_en:
The prefetch region. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland only
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)

If you do not specify this parameter, the default prefetch region is the CDN acceleration region configured for your domain name.


If you want to set the prefetch region to global, make sure that the acceleration region of the accelerated domain name is set to global, and do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
预热区域，取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。

如果不传该参数，默认的预热区域为您的域名所配置的CDN加速区域。


如果需要预热区域为全球，则必须保证加速域名的加速区域为全球，然后该参数不传参
parameters.name: area

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to prefetch content directly to Layer 2 (L2) nodes. Valid values:

true: Prefetches content to L2 nodes.
false: Prefetches content only to origin fetch nodes. This is the default value. Origin fetch nodes can be L2 or Layer 3 (L3) nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否直接预热到L2节点。取值：

true：代表预热的节点层级必须包含L2节点。
false：代表仅预热回源层节点（false为默认值，回源层节点可能是L2节点，也可能是L3节点）
parameters.name: l2_preload
with_header

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the hash key query mode when executing prefetch tasks. Valid values:
false: The default mode. Used when this parameter is not specified. The submitted URL is directly used as the hash key of the prefetched file.
true: Queries the actual hash key used for the prefetch URL based on the domain name configuration
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于控制执行预热任务时是否开启hashkey查询模式。取值范围：
false：默认模式，不传参数的时候使用该模式，指的是直接使用提交的URL作为预热文件的hashkey。
true：根据域名的配置来查询预热URL实际使用的hashkey
parameters.name: query_hashkey

parameters.help_en:
If the acceleration region of the domain name is the Chinese mainland and hash-based origin fetch is enabled, you can use this parameter to enable hash-based prefetching. This implements regional origin fetch convergence and reduces the back-to-origin bandwidth generated by prefetching. Valid values:

true: Enables hash-based prefetching.
false: The default logic. Hash-based prefetching is disabled.

<notice>This parameter is valid only for domain names whose acceleration region is the Chinese mainland.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
如果域名加速区域为中国大陆并且开启了HASH回源，可通过此参数设置HASH预热，实现区域回源收敛，减少预热产生的回源带宽。

true： 开启HASH预热。
false： 缺省逻辑，不开启HASH预热。

<notice>仅对加速区域为中国大陆的域名有效。></notice>
parameters.name: consistency_hash

PushTaskId.description_en:
The ID of the prefetch task. Multiple task IDs are separated by commas (,). The returned task IDs are merged based on the following rules:

Prefetch tasks (at the URL granularity) submitted for the same domain name within the same second are merged into the same PushTaskId.
If the number of prefetch tasks (at the URL granularity) submitted for the same domain name within the same second exceeds 500, the tasks are merged into one PushTaskId for every 500 tasks
PushTaskId.description_zh:
预热返回的任务ID，多个任务ID用半角逗号（,）分隔。预热返回的任务ID会按照以下两条规则对预热任务做合并：

同一个域名、同一秒钟提交的预热任务（URL颗粒度）会被合并为同一个PushTaskId。
同一个域名、同一秒钟提交的预热任务（URL颗粒度）如果超过500条，那么会按照每500条合并为一个PushTaskId的方式处理
